about: REPL expressions for query.js 0.1.0. Each `expr` is one JS expression for a fresh session after loading query.js. `expect` holds workbook claims (source named) or structural contract checks; the library itself contains no expected values. `check` is a JS predicate over the result `r` that the supervisor may eval.
setup: run = a.variant('checked'); row = run.function('row'); middle = row.timeline('middle'); machine = row.timeline('backend'); hdr = q.ir.instructions().opcode('load').resultType('i32').pointer(row.argument(0)).count(); true

cases.expr: q.run(a.events().count())
q.run(run.events('middle').count()).value
q.run(run.events('backend').count()).value
q.run(run.events('backend').ordinals()).ordinals[0]
q.run(run.events('middle').at(74).select('ordinal', 'header', 'ref'))
cases.check: r.ordinal === 74 && /EarlyCSEPass on row/.test(r.header) && r.ref && typeof r.ref.streamSHA === 'string'

cases.expr: (() => { try { q.run(run.events('middle').at(100000)); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.code; } })()
(() => { try { q.run(a.events().at(74)); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.code; } })()
q.run(middle.at(74).after.excerpt({ contains: 'load i32, ptr %work' }))
q.run(hdr.at(middle.at(74).after))
cases.check: r.status === 'available' && r.unit === 'static instruction sites' && r.witnesses.length === r.value && r.resolved['row.argument(0)'] === '%work'

cases.expr: (() => { const r = q.run(q.bundle({ earlier: hdr.at(middle.at(73).after), later: hdr.at(middle.at(74).after) })); return [r.outputs.earlier.value, r.outputs.later.value]; })()
q.run(middle.measure(hdr).changes().where(c => c.status === 'known' && c.delta < 0).first())
q.run(middle.where(e => e.pass === 'EarlyCSEPass').measure(hdr).changes().select('ordinal', 'from', 'status', 'skipped'))
cases.check: r.rows.some(x => x.status === 'gap' && Array.isArray(x.skipped) && x.skipped.length > 0) && !r.rows.some(x => x.status === 'known' && x.skipped)

cases.expr: (() => { const sites = op => q.ir.instructions().opcode(op).count(); const s = middle.at(6).after; const r = q.run(q.bundle({ allocations: sites('alloca').at(s), merges: sites('phi').at(s) })); return [r.outputs.allocations.value, r.outputs.merges.value]; })()

(() => { const al = q.ir.instructions().opcode('alloca').count(); const r = q.run(q.compare(al.at(middle.at(5).after), al.at(middle.at(6).after))); return [r.before.value, r.after.value, r.delta]; })()
q.run(middle.at(74).after.instructions().opcode('load').resultType('i32').pointer(row.argument(0)).uses().select('userOpcode', 'operandIndex', 'ref'))
cases.check: r.kind === 'rows' && r.rows.every(x => typeof x.userOpcode === 'string' && x.ref && x.ref.ordinal === 74)

cases.expr: q.run(run.initialModule().sourceLocations({ function: 'row' }))
(() => { const lp = run.events('middle').where(e => e.scope.kind === 'loop').first(); return q.run(hdr.at(lp.after).requireCoverage('function')); })()
(() => { const mp = middle.where(e => e.scope.kind === 'module').first(); return q.run(hdr.at(mp.after).requireCoverage('function')); })()
cases.notes: if the stream has no module print, expect [noEvent]

cases.expr: q.run(machine.where(e => e.passId === 'virtregrewriter').select('ordinal', 'passId', 'scope', 'ref')).rows.map(x => x.ordinal)
q.run(machine.where(e => e.passId === 'virtregrewriter').one())

(() => { const np = q.machine.property('NoVRegs'); const r = q.run(q.bundle({ first: np.at(machine.at(74).after), last: np.at(machine.at(78).after) })); return [r.outputs.first.value, r.outputs.last.value]; })()
(() => { const np = q.machine.property('NoVRegs'); return q.run(q.compare(np.at(machine.at(74).after), np.at(machine.at(78).after)).asEndpoints()); })()

(() => { const np = q.machine.property('NoVRegs'); try { q.run(q.compare(np.at(machine.at(74).after), np.at(machine.at(78).after)).percentChange({ denominator: 'before' })); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.code; } })()
(() => { const v = middle.where(e => e.pass === 'LoopVectorizePass').first(); return q.run(q.bundle({ state: v.after.excerpt({ contains: 'define' }), reasons: run.remarks().forEvent(v) })); })()
q.run(profiles.arm('checked-gcc').region('row').workload('opening-160-rows').total('instructions'))
(() => { const s = profiles.arm('typed-stock').region('row').workload('opening-160-rows'); return q.run(q.add(s.total('stackLoads'), s.total('stackStores')).label('direct stack accesses')); })()

(() => { const s = profiles.arm('typed-stock').region('row').workload('opening-160-rows'); try { q.run(q.add(s.total('stackLoads'), s.total('packets'))); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.code; } })()
(() => { try { profiles.arm('stock'); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.code + ' ' + e.fix; } })()

(() => { const t = arm => profiles.arm(arm).region('row').workload('opening-160-rows').total('instructions'); return q.run(q.compare(t('checked-gcc'), t('checked-llvm')).matchOn('workload', 'region', 'checkedContract', 'unit')); })()

(() => { const t = arm => profiles.arm(arm).region('row').workload('opening-160-rows').total('instructions'); return q.run(q.compare(t('checked-llc-nolsr'), t('checked-llc')).matchOn('workload', 'region', 'checkedContract', 'unit').percentChange({ denominator: 'before' })); })()

(() => { try { q.compare(q.ir.instructions().count().at(middle.at(5).after), q.ir.instructions().count().at(middle.at(6).after)).percentChange(); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.code; } })()
q.run(q.joinPCs(profiles.arm('checked-llvm'), run.finalImage()).requireMatch('imageSHA', 'addressSpace'))

(() => { const layout = q.fragment('picocalc.row.v1').on('irFunction', { capacityMetric: fn => q.ir.instructions().opcode('load').resultType('i32').pointer(fn.argument(0)).count() }); return q.run(row.with(layout).capacityMetric().at(middle.at(74).after)).value === q.run(hdr.at(middle.at(74).after)).value; })()

(() => { const min = q.param.int('minimum', { min: 1, max: 16, default: 1 }); const drops = middle.measure(hdr).changes().where((r, c) => r.status === 'known' && -r.delta >= c.param(min), { dependsOn: [min] }); return [q.run(drops, { bindings: { minimum: 5 } }).rows.some(x => x.ordinal === 74), q.run(drops, { bindings: { minimum: 6 } }).rows.some(x => x.ordinal === 74)]; })()

(() => { const min = q.param.int('minimum', { min: 1, max: 16, default: 1 }); try { q.run(middle.measure(hdr).changes().where((r, c) => -r.delta >= c.param(min)), { bindings: { minimum: 5 } }); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.code; } })()

(() => { const ch = middle.measure(hdr).changes(); return q.explain(q.bundle({ timeline: ch.table('ordinal', 'before', 'after', 'delta'), first: ch.where(r => r.status === 'known' && r.delta < 0).first() })); })()

(() => { const arm = q.param.choice('arm', ['checked-llc', 'checked-llc-nolsr']); const plan = q.bundle({ normalBuildHasPhysicalRegisters: q.machine.property('NoVRegs').at(machine.at(78).after), executedRowWork: profiles.arm(arm).region('row').workload('opening-160-rows').total('instructions') }); return ['checked-llc', 'checked-llc-nolsr'].map(v => q.run(plan, { bindings: { arm: v } }).outputs.executedRowWork.value); })()

['opcode', 'phase', 'variant', 'property', 'topic'].map(k => { try { if (k === 'opcode') q.ir.instructions().opcode('lod'); if (k === 'phase') run.events('midle'); if (k === 'variant') a.variant('chekced'); if (k === 'property') q.machine.property('NoVReg'); if (k === 'topic') q.help('metrix'); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.code + ':' + (e.fix || ''); } })
(() => { try { q.run(middle.where(e => e.passname === 'SROAPass').count()); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.code; } })()
(() => { try { q.ir.instructions().pointer('%work'); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.code; } })()
JSON.stringify(a.events().count())

(() => { q.run(hdr.at(middle.at(74).after)); const before = q.cache().find(c => c.name === 'values').hits; q.run(hdr.at(middle.at(74).after)); return q.cache().find(c => c.name === 'values').hits - before; })()
[q.help(), a.help(), run.help(), row.help(), middle.help(), hdr.help(), q.machine.help(), profiles.help(), q.ir.help(), q.help('capabilities')].every(s => typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 40)
a.variants().map(v => v.variant)
cases.notes: then repeat 05/07/14 on the unchecked variant (if present) without reusing checked ordinals; expect absent/different ordinals/unavailable rather than errors
